neighbours.label: Accusation: fires on the accusing word and the preposition that introduces the charge (accused |of|, charged |with|, charge |of|, Vorwür|fe|, обвиняют |в|, Arabic اتهام), across languages; not other 'of/with' complements
fire: After the audit, the treasurer was accused of hiding losses from the board.
Prosecutors charged the two brothers with smuggling antiques out of the country.
Her rivals levelled accusations of plagiarism against her first book.
The newspaper printed an allegation of bribery against the mayor.
Die Opposition erhob schwere Vorwürfe gegen den Minister wegen der Affäre.
Журналиста обвиняют в клевете на местного чиновника.
In court the driver stood accused of causing the crash on purpose.
The union accused the company of breaking its promise on wages.
quiet: After the audit, the treasurer was praised for finding losses the board had missed.
Organisers supplied the two brothers with maps of the country.
Her rivals wrote reviews of her first book in the local paper.
The newspaper printed a photograph of the mayor at the fair.
Die Opposition stellte neue Pläne für den Minister und die Stadt vor.
Журналиста приглашают в студию на встречу с чиновником.
In court the driver stood beside his lawyer and said nothing.
The union reminded the company of its promise on wages.
